hotels.vendor_name: Aulūs Lindos Rhodes, by Domes Resorts
hotels.title: Family-Friendly Rhodes Oceanfront Escape with Onsite Dining, Spa & Kids' Club
hotels.description: Sitting along the sun-drenched coast of Rhodes, close to the whitewashed lanes of Lindos village, Aulūs Lindos Rhodes by Domes is a dreamy all-inclusive resort built with families in mind. Spacious suites and private-pool retreats open onto sunlit terraces, with the warm light and relaxed pace of the Greek islands setting the tone from arrival. Dining is entirely taken care of across four restaurants - spanning Mediterranean comfort, Italian flair and Greek family recipes - along with a 24/7 buffet, food-fest evenings, grab-and-go beach bites and premium drinks at two bars throughout the day. KiEPOS Kids Club keeps younger guests happily occupied, while Soma Spa offers ELEMIS and Codage Paris treatments for parents looking to unwind.

hotels.vendor_name: Caesars Gardens Hotel & Spa - Adults Only- Rhodes, Greece
hotels.title: Boutique Greek Island Adults-Only Retreat with Outdoor Pool & Onsite Spa
hotels.description: Seamlessly blending into Rhodes' natural landscape, this intimate, adults-only hotel is where Greek Island sophistication meets rustic charm. The crown jewel is the Magnolia Spa, featuring outdoor treatment pavillions amid ancient olive trees, while Tárate Restaurant serves traditional Greek cuisine using herbs and vegetables from the hotel's garden. Beyond the hotel's tranquil grounds, guests can explore Rhodes' immense southeastern coastline, with pristine beaches and hidden coves dotting the shoreline. Adventure seekers can discover ancient ruins perched dramatically on clifftops, while the nearby village of Lindos captivates with its maze of whitewashed alleyways, traditional tavernas and local craft boutiques.
